name: Cumbia
label: CUMBIA
source: Burgos 2017 (UPN Bogota thesis, after Valencia 2004 Pitos y tambores) sec. 3.2.2-3.2.4; Orphiq, What is cumbia; 2/4; one common way to play it

sources.title: Burgos Palomino, J. A. (2017), Berroche, trabajo de grado, Universidad Pedagogica Nacional
sources.shows: pulse: 'golpe a tiempo con baqueta en madera en tambora de cumbia'; binary division (down on the beat, up on the offbeat) for maraca and guacho; 'contratiempo binario' for the llamador de cumbia

sources.title: Orphiq, What Is Cumbia? Origins, Rhythm, and Regional Styles
sources.shows: llamador marks the weak pulses, the offbeats, and holds steady; tambora low accents on the strong beats; guache or maraca running eighths; meter 2/2 or 2/4; 85 to 110 bpm commonly quoted
